soldier: Body yellow tinged with brown overall, legs slightly paler. Minor soldier: head oval, 1.2 to 1.4 times as long as wide, fontanelle behind the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched and the postmentum markedly projecting; mandibles slender, reaching more than two thirds of the head capsule in length, the apex slender and straight, the inner margin of the left mandible with fine teeth from the midpoint onwards; antennae with 17 segments; postmentum a narrow band, the sides nearly parallel. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum shallowly concave, the lateral lobes of the prothorax and metathorax not markedly angular, the sides of the mesonotum nearly parallel; hind tibia longer than the head width.
